_about: lanePITCLIPS data for Pitborn (enemy). rows -> attack_clips.json 'rows'; bakeAttacks -> attack_clips.json 'bake'; bakeDodges -> dodge_clips.json 'bake'; controllerStates = what Pitborn.controller must contain afterwards (AttackClipSetup / DodgeClipSetup create them from the staged glbs; HCKIT5 CharacterSetup EnsureStates adds a state when <folder>/AttackClips|DodgeClips/<state>.anim exists). Times are seconds in the SOURCE clip (rows measured from the baked clips: work/windows.json).

rows.note: hand rises to apex 0.50 s (hold 0.35 = cocked right, rising; release x0.68 is inside the 0.6 speed floor), then descends R-to-L across the body: hand crosses the centre line at 0.60 s, right-hand speed peak 0.55 s (12 m/s), settled 1.23 s. Source travel 0.33 m baked out (inplace), same as the live Pitborn rows.

hands rise up-left from 0.2 s (start 0.2: a start of 0.0 would need x3.9 to reach the hold, the cap is x2.6) to the cocked pose 0.50 s (hold 0.50), then L-to-R diagonal slash: right-hand speed peak 0.80 s (7.7 m/s), settled 1.67 s; clip 1.83 s. Source travel 0.68 m baked out.

hands drawn back-right 0.2-0.4 s (hold 0.25, release x0.68), forward drive peaks 0.43 s (8.3 m/s), max forward reach 0.50-0.55 s (contact 0.50), settled 0.73 s; clip 1.2 s, travel 0.12 m baked out. The pack has no extended-arm thrust (hands reach 0.5 m from the shoulders in all 8 attacks): this is the closest forward drive. Not measured in play.

0.0-0.9 s is a preparatory two-sided swing (too long for a light attack; skipped: start 0.95 = 0.45 s of wind-up to contact, like the Dracula/Joan light rows, blendIn 0.08 because it starts mid-motion), apex 1.17 s (hand 2.03 m), downward chop speed peak 1.40 s (5.1 m/s, hand drops 0.7 m in 0.3 s), settled 1.53 s; clip 1.8 s (end 1.8 so the recovery runs at x0.8, 1.75 gave x0.7). Source travel 1.08 m baked out (the largest of the four).
